problems.name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
problems.skeleton_head:
intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      exact Hin
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ?_
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply fn_ih
        exact H1
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply e_ih
        exact H2
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    a
